quarterly_data.quarter: Yamaha Motor semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (January-June 2026) consolidated results: revenue JPY 1,497,989 million (+17.2% year on year), operating profit JPY 158,476 million (+88.6%), interim profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 113,900 million (+114.7%); exchange rates USD 158 yen and EUR 185 yen. Management states revenue rose mainly on higher motorcycle sales, and operating profit rose on higher unit sales, exchange rates and lower SG&A despite US tariffs and higher procurement costs. Segment revenue / segment profit: Land Mobility JPY 984,558 million (+21.8%) / JPY 112,731 million; Marine JPY 300,669 million (+7.4%) / JPY 46,042 million; Outdoor Land Vehicle JPY 80,289 million / loss JPY 11,981 million; Robotics JPY 60,120 million / JPY 3,665 million; Financial Services JPY 63,638 million / JPY 12,127 million. Purchases of property, plant, equipment and intangibles JPY 58,439 million; group R&D spending JPY 72.9 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 1,497,989 million (+17.2%); operating profit JPY 158,476 million (+88.6%); profit attributable to owners JPY 113,900 million (+114.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Yamaha Motor semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Robotics segment, H1 FY2026: revenue JPY 60,120 million (+24.5% year on year), segment profit JPY 3,665 million (prior-year period loss JPY 1,541 million). Management states surface mounter sales were strong, centred on China, the main market, and industrial robot unit sales rose as demand recovered; demand for semiconductor back-end manufacturing equipment from generative AI and advanced packaging kept growing, but the company's own sales of that equipment were below the prior-year period because of shipment timing. Profit improved on lower SG&A.
quarterly_data.figure: Robotics revenue JPY 60,120 million (+24.5%); segment profit JPY 3,665 million (prior-year loss JPY 1,541 million)
